description: Test suite for the SQL store component of Mattermost's channel storage, including database migration, connection, and replica handling tests.

methods.description: Creates a new storeType with specified name and driver.

methods.name: StoreTestWithSqlStore
methods.description: Runs a test function with a SQL store wrapper across all store instances.
